integrity: The final claim is proved analytically from the Bell-basis eigenvalue parametrization and the standard Bell-diagonal geometric-discord formula. Exact-rational computation is supplementary and not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to two-qubit Bell-diagonal states and squared Hilbert–Schmidt geometric discord; no operational monotonicity claim is made. Bibliographic searches reduce but cannot eliminate residual novelty risk.
title: Exact fixed-concurrence envelope for Bell-diagonal Hilbert–Schmidt geometric discord
